scope: Read-only preflight of four controlled native functional cases; source acceptance r2 retained. No tests or native acquisition performed. No formal lifecycle/currentness/epoch authority.
supported: Actual ReferenceRenderClient sends kind render/id/job; modified view.width=0 reaches the production worker invalid-view error path, rather than a fabricated host error.
Foreground and detail faults target the changed owners; before/after assertions are falsifiers, not timing or physical-continuity qualification.
The build receipt binds the previously accepted r2 source hashes and reports two equal 142-file builds; this preflight did not independently rehash all runtime files.

findings.finding: The held native-data request spans asynchronous waits and screenshots while the actual native asset deadline is 15000 ms. A slow case can test an induced asset timeout instead of the requested worker error.
findings.required: Record held-request entry/release timing; release or fail the fixture before the unchanged native deadline, then assert full assets ready before the worker fault. Do not extend product timeout.

findings.finding: A rejected context.close skips browser/server cleanup and runtime readback. The outer finally nevertheless removes the resource lock; unbounded close/evaluate paths also lack an enclosing finite acquisition bound.
findings.required: Independent bounded cleanup attempts and preserved outcomes; verify owned browser containment before releasing a clean lease. Gate successful return on cleanup. Use a finite outer case/run guard for existing unbounded awaits.

findings.finding: Runtime identity is observed but not compared to the declared r27/r28 roots before launch; runtimeUnchanged is recorded without gating success.
findings.required: Assert both expected runtime roots before effects and reject successful comparison if the post identity differs.

findings.finding: The error wait accepts any growth in sky.errors, while the injected request identity is separately recorded.
findings.required: Assert the production invalid-width error attributable to the injected request; preserve unrelated error events rather than satisfying this falsifier with them.

limits: No S1, callback-cost, continuous pixels, whole visual, or production readiness credit.
No new agent, browser, test/build, source/Git mutation, or external effect.
